cohort: A 21-year-old Gravida 3, Para 2 woman at 36 weeks and 3 days of gestation, with a history of early neonatal death and a stillbirth, presenting with symptoms suggestive of heart failure.
finding: This case illustrates the successful multidisciplinary management of Peripartum Cardiomyopathy (PPCM) presenting with exaggerated normal pregnancy symptoms, highlighting the importance of screening echocardiograms in the third trimester for prompt diagnosis.
